how: Reviewer-recorded on DGX Spark (Linux aarch64) as the dedicated test user zylos-test with a temporary HOME and CODEX_HOME, logged in with an API key (removed after recording), interactive `codex --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` in a private tmux socket (pane 200x50). One small real turn that ran the shell command `echo ok` and replied DONE. transcript.jsonl holds three unmodified lines copied from the rollout file, in this order: session_meta, the assistant message before the tool call, and the tool call. This version records the shell call as response_item custom_tool_call (name exec), not function_call. sessionId is session_meta payload.id; startedAt is the session_meta timestamp (Unix ms).

files.transcript.jsonl: Line 1: session_meta. Line 2: assistant message with output_text. Line 3: custom_tool_call (exec).
